stemMd: Two nonzero vectors have scalar product zero. What can be concluded about their directions?

options.label: B
options.textMd: They are parallel in opposite directions.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They are parallel in the same direction.

explanationMd: The scalar product is the product of magnitudes times cosine of the angle. Nonzero magnitudes and a zero product require cosine zero, so the angle is 90 degrees.

distractorRationale.b: That gives a negative scalar product.
distractorRationale.a: The stem explicitly excludes zero vectors.
distractorRationale.e: That gives a positive scalar product.
distractorRationale.c: Orthogonality does not constrain their magnitudes.
